the M line consists of three or four arrays of transverse bridges, 200 Å apart, and of M filaments, which pass through the M line.
the M line is a structure that is located in the middle of each A band of a sarcomere and is composed of three arrays of transverse bridges and of M filaments.

In summary, our research is concerned with
a detailed study of the structure of the myofibril and of the contractile mechanism of skeletal muscle.
the ultrastructure of a specialized region of the sarcomere, the so-called M line, and the role it plays in the contraction process.
the structure and possible function of the Z and M lines of skeletal muscle.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the M line is a structural component of the A band which is essential in maintaining the structural integrity of the A band and the A filaments in the sarcomere.
the M line is an array of transverse M filaments and M bridges which are arranged in a regular pattern.
the M line, as well as the Z line, is a structural unit of the A band, and that the A band is a structural unit in its own right.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the M line is an array of M bridges which are connected together by M filaments and that it is a structural element which plays an important role in the mechanism of contraction.
the M line consists of a framework of M filaments, which are linked to each other by M bridges.
in skeletal muscle the Z line is a structural element that holds the sarcomeres together and the M line is a structural component that holds the A filaments together.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the M line is a structure with a complex architecture that may be involved in the transmission of the force from the A filaments to the M filaments.
the M line, like the Z line, has an important role in the maintenance of the A-filament lattice and the regulation of the sarcomere length.
the M line is an essential structural component of the sarcomere.
